newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile reports July inflation 0.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chile reports July inflation 0.6 percent.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 0.6 percent last month, bringing the rise in inflation in the first seven months of the year to 3.1 percent, said the National Statistics Institute (INE).
The INE figures showed inflation rising 5.6 percent over the 12 months to July.
Consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in July last year, with an increase of 7.7 percent in the year ending July 1996. Prices rose 4.1 percent in the first seven months of last year.
Inflation was stoked last month by a sharp 1.6 percent increase in food prices, a 0.8 percent rise in the "other"category and a 0.1 percent rise in transport and communications costs.
Analysts had been expecting vegetable prices to rise last month as a result of flooding in June which destroyed crops in agricultural areas near Santiago.
The figures showed clothing prices fell 0.9 percent in July, while housing costs dropped 0.3 percent.
